自动化 Excel 报表生成工具，支持从多种数据源生成专业的 Excel 报告。

- 📊 从 CSV、数据库或 Python 数据结构生成 Excel 报表

import re
from collections import Counter

STOPWORDS = {
    'the','and','or','to','of','in','a','an','is','are','was','were','be','been','being',
    'with','for','on','at','by','as','from','that','this','these','those','it','its','their','there',
    'define','explain','write','what','why','how','when','where','which','describe','differentiate','between',
    'give','state','list','draw','illustrate','example','examples','advantages','disadvantages','short','long',
    'mcqs','question','questions','marks','note','brief','detail','diagram','following','using','use'
}

DOMAIN_STOP = {
    # very generic CS words that dominate but don't help curriculum planning much
    'program','programs','programming','computer','computers','data','system','systems','language','languages',
    'c','cpp','java','sql','dbms','database','databases'
}

TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_+-]{1,}")

def tokenize(text: str):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return []
    # normalize $ separator to space
    text = text.replace('$', ' ')
    text = text.lower()
    toks = TOKEN_RE.findall(text)
    toks = [t.strip("_+-") for t in toks]
    toks = [t for t in toks if len(t) >= 3]
    toks = [t for t in toks if t not in STOPWORDS]
    return toks


df = pd.read_csv('benchmark/data.csv')
df['tokens'] = df['question'].map(tokenize)

# overall keyword counts

overall_counts = Counter(all_tokens)

# overall top keywords (raw)
top_overall = overall_counts.most_common(30)
print('Top overall (raw):')
print(top_overall[:20])

# filtered top keywords (remove DOMAIN_STOP)

top_filtered = filtered_counts.most_common(30)
print('\nTop overall (filtered):')
print(top_filtered[:25])

# per year top keywords (filtered)
per_year = {}
for year, sub in df.groupby('year'):
    toks = [t for row in sub['tokens'] for t in row if t not in DOMAIN_STOP]
    per_year[year] = Counter(toks).most_common(10)

print('\nSample per-year top tokens (2015,2017,2025):')

# bigrams

def bigrams(tokens):
    return list(zip(tokens, tokens[1:]))

bg = Counter()
for toks in df['tokens']:
    toks2 = [t for t in toks if t not in DOMAIN_STOP]
    bg.update(bigrams(toks2))

print('\nTop bigrams (filtered):', bg.most_common(15))
